199:           g_uart.state_pending = true;
200:           if (g_uart.tx_retry_count == 0)
201:             {
202:               /* Keep tx_read unchanged.  The same chunk may be copied again
203:                * once STATE recovery succeeds, but only once.
204:                */
205: 
206:               g_uart.tx_retry_count = 1;
207:               g_uart.stats.tx_retry++;
208:             }
209:           else
210:             {
211:               g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
212:                                MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
213:               g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
214:               g_uart.stats.tx_retry_drop++;
215:             }
216:         }
217: 
218:       g_uart.tx_inflight = 0;
219:     }
220:   else if (command == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE && failed)
221:     {
222:       g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
223:       /* The transport invokes this completion before it changes READY to
224:        * ABORTING.  Always retain a STATE request so RESET recovery has a
225:        * probe to send after it reaches PROBING.
226:        */
227: 
228:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
229:     }
230: 
231:   g_uart.transaction_busy = false;
232:   up_irq_restore(flags);
233:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
234: }

236: static int mb_uart_receive(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
237:                            uint8_t *ack_flags, void *arg)
238: {
239:   uint8_t command = bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message);
240:   uint16_t length = message->payload_length;
241:   uint16_t first;
242:   bool failed = false;
243:   bool malformed = false;
244: 
245:   (void)arg;
246:   if (ack_flags == NULL)
247:     {
248:       return -EINVAL;
249:     }
250: 
251:   if (command != BK7258_MB_UART_DATA && command != BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
252:     {
253:       g_uart.stats.bad_flags++;
254:       failed = true;
255:       malformed = true;
256:     }
257:   else if ((message->flags & ~1u) != 0)
258:     {
259:       g_uart.stats.bad_flags++;
260:       failed = true;
261:       malformed = true;
262:     }
263:   else if (message->crc8 != 0)
264:     {
265:       g_uart.stats.bad_crc++;
266:       g_uart.sticky_status |= MB_UART_STATUS_PARITY;
267:       failed = true;
268:       malformed = true;
269:     }
270:   else if (message->reserved != 0)
271:     {
272:       g_uart.stats.bad_reserved++;
273:       failed = true;
274:       malformed = true;
275:     }
276: 
277:   if (!failed && command == BK7258_MB_UART_DATA)
278:     {
279:       if (message->payload_address != BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS)
280:         {
281:           g_uart.stats.bad_pointer++;
282:           failed = true;
283:           malformed = true;
284:         }
285:       else if (length == 0 || length > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE)
286:         {
287:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
288:           failed = true;
289:           malformed = true;
290:         }
291:       else if (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
292:         {
293:           failed = true;
294:         }
295:       else if (rx_free() < length)
296:         {
297:           g_uart.stats.rx_overflow++;
298:           g_uart.sticky_status |= MB_UART_STATUS_OVF;
299:           failed = true;
300:         }
301:       else
302:         {
303:           const uint8_t *source =
304:             (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS;
305: 
306:           __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
307:           first = MB_UART_RX_SIZE - g_uart.rx_write;
308:           if (first > length)
309:             {
310:               first = length;
311:             }
312: 
313:           memcpy(&g_uart.rx_ring[g_uart.rx_write], source, first);
314:           if (first != length)
315:             {
316:               memcpy(g_uart.rx_ring, source + first, length - first);
317:             }
318: 
319:           g_uart.rx_write = (g_uart.rx_write + length) % MB_UART_RX_SIZE;
320:           g_uart.stats.data_rx++;
321:           g_uart.stats.rx_bytes += length;
322:         }
323:     }
324:   else if (!failed)
325:     {
326:       if (message->payload_address != 0 || message->payload_length != 0)
327:         {
328:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
329:           failed = true;
330:           malformed = true;
331:         }
332:       else
333:         {
334:           g_uart.stats.state_rx++;
335:         }
336:     }
337: 
338:   if (!malformed)
339:     {
340:       bool old_peer_rts = g_uart.peer_rts;
341: 
342:       g_uart.peer_rts = (message->flags & 1u) != 0;
343:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = true;
344:       if (old_peer_rts && !g_uart.peer_rts)
345:         {
346:           nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
347:         }
348:     }
349: 
350:   update_local_rts();
351:   *ack_flags = (g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u) | (failed ? 2u : 0u);
352:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
353:   return malformed ? -EPROTO : OK;
354: }

356: static int send_state_locked(void)
357: {
358:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
359:   int ret;
360: 
361:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
362:   message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(BK7258_MB_UART_STATE, 0, 0, 0,
363:                                          BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX);
364:   message.flags = g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u;
365:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX, &message,
366:                                   mb_uart_tx_complete, NULL);
367:   if (ret == OK)
368:     {
369:       g_uart.transaction_busy = true;
370:       g_uart.transaction_command = BK7258_MB_UART_STATE;
371:       g_uart.state_pending = false;
372:       g_uart.stats.state_tx++;
373:     }
374: 
375:   return ret;
376: }

378: static int send_data_locked(void)
379: {
380:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
381:   uint8_t *destination =
382:     (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_MB_UART_TX_ADDRESS;
383:   uint16_t length = tx_count();
384:   uint16_t first;
385:   int ret;
386: 
387:   if (length > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE)
388:     {
389:       length = BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE;
390:     }
391: 
392:   if (length == 0 || g_uart.peer_rts)
393:     {
394:       return -EAGAIN;
395:     }
396: 
397:   first = MB_UART_TX_SIZE - g_uart.tx_read;
398:   if (first > length)
399:     {
400:       first = length;
401:     }
402: 
403:   memcpy(destination, &g_uart.tx_ring[g_uart.tx_read], first);
404:   if (first != length)
405:     {
406:       memcpy(destination + first, g_uart.tx_ring, length - first);
407:     }
408: 
409:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
410:   message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(BK7258_MB_UART_DATA, 0, 0, 0,
411:                                          BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX);
412:   message.payload_address = BK7258_MB_UART_TX_ADDRESS;
413:   message.payload_length = length;
414:   message.flags = g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u;
415:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
416:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX, &message,
417:                                   mb_uart_tx_complete, NULL);
418:   if (ret == OK)
419:     {
420:       g_uart.transaction_busy = true;
421:       g_uart.transaction_command = BK7258_MB_UART_DATA;
422:       g_uart.tx_inflight = length;
423:       g_uart.stats.data_tx++;
424:     }
425: 
426:   return ret;
427: }

429: static int mb_uart_worker(int argc, char **argv)
430: {
431:   (void)argc;
432:   (void)argv;
433: 
434:   for (;;)
435:     {
436:       bk7258_mb_uart_callback_t callback;
437:       void *callback_arg;
438:       irqstate_t flags;
439: 
440:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_uart.worker_sem,
441:                                            MB_UART_WORK_INTERVAL);
442:       flags = up_irq_save();
443: 
444:       if (!g_uart.transaction_busy)
445:         {
446:           enum bk7258_mb_link_state link = bk7258_mailbox_link_state();
447: 
448:           if (link == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING && g_uart.state_pending)
449:             {
450:               (void)send_state_locked();
451:             }
452:           else if (link == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
453:             {
454:               if (g_uart.state_pending)
455:                 {
456:                   (void)send_state_locked();
457:                 }
458:               else
459:                 {
460:                   (void)send_data_locked();
461:                 }
462:             }
463:         }
464: 
465:       callback = g_uart.callback;
466:       callback_arg = g_uart.callback_arg;
467:       up_irq_restore(flags);
468: 
469:       if (callback != NULL)
470:         {
471:           callback(callback_arg);
472:         }
473:     }
474: 
475:   return OK;
476: }

488: 
489:   if (g_uart.initialized)

491:       return OK;

503:   g_uart.state_pending = true;

547: ssize_t bk7258_mbox_uart_write(const uint8_t *data, size_t length)
548: {
549:   irqstate_t flags;
550:   uint16_t available;
551:   uint16_t written;
552:   uint16_t first;
553: 
554:   if (data == NULL && length != 0)
555:     {
556:       return -EINVAL;
557:     }
558: 
559:   if (length == 0)
560:     {
561:       return 0;
562:     }
563: 
564:   flags = up_irq_save();
565:   available = tx_free();
566:   written = length > available ? available : length;
567:   first = MB_UART_TX_SIZE - g_uart.tx_write;
568:   if (first > written)
569:     {
570:       first = written;
571:     }
572: 
573:   memcpy(&g_uart.tx_ring[g_uart.tx_write], data, first);
574:   if (first != written)
575:     {
576:       memcpy(g_uart.tx_ring, data + first, written - first);
577:     }
578: 
579:   g_uart.tx_write = (g_uart.tx_write + written) % MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
580:   g_uart.stats.write_calls++;
581:   g_uart.stats.write_bytes += written;
582:   if (written < length)
583:     {
584:       g_uart.stats.short_writes++;
585:     }
586: 
587:   up_irq_restore(flags);
588:   if (g_uart.initialized && written != 0)
589:     {
590:       nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
591:     }
592: 
593:   return written;
594: }

596: ssize_t bk7258_mbox_uart_read(uint8_t *data, size_t length,

598: {
599:   irqstate_t flags;
600:   uint16_t available;
601:   uint16_t count;
602:   uint16_t first;
603: 
604:   if (data == NULL || length == 0)
605:     {
606:       return -EINVAL;
607:     }
608: 
609:   flags = up_irq_save();
610:   available = rx_count();
611:   count = length > available ? available : length;
612:   first = MB_UART_RX_SIZE - g_uart.rx_read;
613:   if (first > count)
614:     {
615:       first = count;
616:     }
617: 
618:   memcpy(data, &g_uart.rx_ring[g_uart.rx_read], first);

620:     {
621:       memcpy(data + first, g_uart.rx_ring, count - first);
622:     }
623: 
624:   g_uart.rx_read = (g_uart.rx_read + count) % MB_UART_RX_SIZE;
625:   if (status != NULL)
626:     {
627:       *status = g_uart.sticky_status;
628:       g_uart.sticky_status = 0;
629:     }

635:     }
636: 
637:   up_irq_restore(flags);
638:   if (g_uart.initialized && count != 0)
639:     {
640:       nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
641:     }
642: 
643:   return count;
644: }

151: static u8 cal_crc8_0x31(u8 *data_buf, u16 len)
152: {
153: 	u8    crc = 0x00;

155: #if MB_UART_CRC8_ENABLE

159: 	}

161: 
162: 	return (crc);
163: }

201: static bool mb_uart_validate_command(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb,
202: 				     mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd, bool data)
203: {
204: 	if (uart_cmd->resvd || uart_cmd->mb_cmd.param3)
205: 		return false;
206: 
207: 	if (data)
208: 	{
209: 		if (uart_cmd->cmd_buff != chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff ||
210: 			uart_cmd->cmd_data_len < 1 ||
211: 			uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > UART_XCHG_DATA_MAX)
212: 			return false;
213: 		return uart_cmd->crc8 == cal_crc8_0x31((u8 *)uart_cmd->cmd_buff,
214: 							 uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
215: 	}
216: 
217: 	return uart_cmd->cmd_buff == NULL && uart_cmd->cmd_data_len == 0 &&
218: 		uart_cmd->crc8 == 0;
219: }

221: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
222: {
223: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
224: 
225: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
226: 
227: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
228: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
229: 
230: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
231: 	{
232: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
233: 	}
234: 	else
235: 	{
236: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
237: 	}
238: 
239: 	if(!mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, true))
240: 	{
241: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
242: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;
243: 		tx_fail = 1;
244: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
245: 	}
246: 
247: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
248: 	{
249: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
250: 		tx_fail = 1;
251: 		
252: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
253: 	}
254: 
255: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
256: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
257: 	#endif
258: 
259: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
260: 
261: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
262: 
263: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
264: 	{
265: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
266: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
267: 	}
268: 	else
269: 	{
270: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
271: 
272: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
273: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
274: 
275: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
276: 		{
277: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
278: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
279: 		}
280: 		else
281: 		{
282: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
283: 
284: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
285: 			{
286: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
287: 			}
288: 
289: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
290: 		}
291: 	}
292: 
293: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
294: 
295: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
296: 	{
297: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
298: 	}
299: 
300: rx_isr_data_xit:
301: 	
302: 	if(free_cnt <= MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN)
303: 	{
304: 		chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 1;
305: 	}
306: 
307: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
308: 
309: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
310: 
311: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
312: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
313: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
314: 	 */
315: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
316: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
317: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
318: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
319: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
320: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
321: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
322: 
323: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
324: 	{
325: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
326: 		{
327: 			/* trigger send! */
328: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
329: 		}
330: 	}
331: 	
332: 	return;
333: }

335: static void rx_isr_state_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd)
336: {
337: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
338: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
339: 	u8 invalid = !mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, false);
340: 
341: 	if (!invalid)
342: 		chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
343: 	else
344: 	{
345: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
346: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;
347: 	}
348: 
349: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
350: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
351: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
352: 	 */
353: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
354: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
355: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
356: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
357: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = invalid;
358: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
359: 
360: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
361: 	{
362: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
363: 		{
364: 			/* trigger send! */
365: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
366: 		}
367: 	}
368: 
369: 	return;
370: }

372: static void mb_uart_rx_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
373: {
374: 	/* clear here, because rts state will be passed in response data! */
375: 	chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
376: 	
377: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
378: 	{
379: 		rx_isr_data_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
380: 	}
381: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
382: 	{
383: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
384: 	}
385: 	else
386: 	{
387: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
388: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
389: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
390: 		 */
391: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
392: 		u8 cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
393: 		memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
394: 		uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
395: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
396: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
397: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
398: 	}
399: 	
400: 	return;
401: }

403: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
404: {
405: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
406: 
407: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
408: 
409: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
410: 
411: 	if ((ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) ||
412: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
413: 	{
414: 		chnl_cb->bad_ack_count++;
415: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
416: 		return;
417: 	}
418: 
419: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
420: 
421: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
422: 	{
423: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
424: 	}
425: 	else if ((uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data1 & ~0x3u) ||
426: 		 uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data2 || uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data3)
427: 	{
428: 		tx_fail = 1;
429: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
430: 	}
431: 	else
432: 	{
433: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
434: 	}
435: 
436: 	if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
437: 	{
438: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx + chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
439: 					 sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
440: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
441: 		chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
442: 	}
443: 	else if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
444: 	{
445: 		if (!chnl_cb->link_ready)
446: 		{
447: 			chnl_cb->link_ready = 1;
448: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_READY;
449: 			chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
450: 			mb_chnl_recovered(GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id));
451: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_READY);
452: 		}
453: 	}
454: 
455: 	if (tx_fail)
456: 	{
457: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
458: 		{
459: 			if (chnl_cb->tx_retry)
460: 			{
461: 				chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
462: 						      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
463: 						     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
464: 				chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
465: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
466: 			}
467: 			else
468: 			{
469: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 1;
470: 			}
471: 		}
472: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
473: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
474: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;
475: 		if (chnl_cb->probe_count < MB_UART_PROBE_MAX)
476: 		{
477: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
478: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() + MB_UART_PROBE_RETRY_MS;
479: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
480: 		}
481: 		else
482: 		{
483: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
484: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
485: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() +
486: 				MB_UART_DOWN_RETRY_MS;
487: 		}
488: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
489: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
490: 			chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
491: 		return;
492: 	}
493: 
494: 	/* try next Tx. */
495: 
496: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
497: 
498: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
499: 	{
500: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
501: 		if (ret_val == BK_OK)
502: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
503: 	}
504: 	if (ret_val != BK_OK)
505: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
506: 
507: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
508: 	{
509: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
510: 	}
511: 
512: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
513: 	{
514: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
515: 	}
516: 
517: 	return;
518: }

520: static void mb_uart_channel_event(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_event_t event)
521: {
522: 	if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT)
523: 	{
524: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
525: 	}
526: 	else if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_SENT)
527: 	{
528: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
529: 		chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
530: 		chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
531: 		chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time();
532: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
533: 	}
534: 	else if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_FAILED)
535: 	{
536: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
537: 		chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
538: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
539: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
540: 	}
541: 	else
542: 	{
543: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len)
544: 		{
545: 			/* Delivery is unknowable after a lost ACK. Drop this chunk instead
546: 			 * of replaying terminal input and making duplicate commands. */
547: 			chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
548: 					      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
549: 					     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
550: 			chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
551: 			chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
552: 			chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
553: 		}
554: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
555: 		chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
556: 		chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time();
557: 		chnl_cb->link_state = event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_TX_TIMEOUT ?
558: 			MB_UART_LINK_ABORTING : MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
559: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET;
560: 		if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET)
561: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
562: 		else
563: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_TIMEOUT);
564: 	}
565: 
566: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
567: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
568: }

627: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
628: {
629: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
630: 
631: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
632: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
633: 
634: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != 0)
635: 	{
636: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
637: 	}
638: 
639: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
640: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
641: 
642: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
643: 	{
644: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
645: 	}
646: 	else
647: 	{
648: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
649: 	}
650: 
651: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
652: 	{
653: 		return BK_FAIL;
654: 	}
655: 
656: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
657: 	{
658: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;
659: 	}
660: 
661: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
662: 	{
663: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
664: 	}
665: 	else
666: 	{
667: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - rd_idx;
668: 
669: 		if(rem_len >= cpy_len)
670: 		{
671: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
672: 		}
673: 		else
674: 		{
675: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
676: 
677: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff + rem_len, chnl_cb->tx_buf, cpy_len - rem_len);
678: 		}
679: 	}
680: 
681: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
682: 
683: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
684: 
685: 	memset(&uart_cmd, 0, sizeof(uart_cmd));
686: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
687: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = (void *)(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff);
688: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cpy_len;
689: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
690: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
691: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = cal_crc8_0x31(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, cpy_len);
692: 
693: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
694: 
695: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
696: 	{
697: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = cpy_len;
698: 	}
699: 
700: 	return ret_val;
701: }

703: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data_trigger(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
704: {
705: 	u32 flag = mb_uart_enter_critical();
706: 
707: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_in_process != 0)
708: 	{
709: 		mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
710: 		return BK_OK;
711: 	}
712: 
713: 	chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 1;
714: 
715: 	mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
716: 
717: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
718: 
719: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
720: 
721: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
722: 	{
723: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
724: 	}
725: 
726: 	return ret_val;
727: }

737: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = NULL;
738: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = 0;
739: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
740: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
741: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = 0;

743: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
744: 
745: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);

754: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_in_process != 0)

757: 		mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
758: 		return BK_OK;
759: 	}

761: 	chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 1;
762: 
763: 	mb_uart_exit_critical(flag);
764: 
765: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
766: 
767: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
768: 
769: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
770: 	{
771: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
772: 	}
773: 
774: 	return ret_val;

777: static u16 mb_uart_write_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 data_len)
778: {
779: 	u16    rem_len, wr_len;
780: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
781: 	
782: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
783: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
784: 
785: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
786: 	{
787: 		rem_len = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
788: 	}
789: 	else
790: 	{
791: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
792: 	}
793: 
794: 	wr_len = data_len;
795: 	if(wr_len > rem_len)
796: 		wr_len = rem_len;
797: 
798: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
799: 	{
800: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
801: 	}
802: 	else
803: 	{
804: 		if(rd_idx != 0)
805: 			rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - wr_idx;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
806: 
807: 		if(rem_len >= wr_len)
808: 		{
809: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
810: 		}
811: 		else
812: 		{
813: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, rem_len);
814: 
815: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf, data_buf + rem_len, wr_len - rem_len);
816: 		}
817: 	}
818: 
819: 	chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx = (wr_idx + wr_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
820: 
821: 	/* trigger send! */
822: 	mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
823: 
824: 	return wr_len;
825: }
826: 
827: static u16 mb_uart_read_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 buf_len)
828: {
829: 	u16    rem_len, rd_len;
830: 
831: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
832: 		return 0;
833: 
834: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, data_cnt;
835: 
836: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
837: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
838: 
839: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
840: 	{
841: 		data_cnt = wr_idx - rd_idx;
842: 	}
843: 	else
844: 	{
845: 		data_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
846: 	}
847: 
848: 	rd_len = data_cnt;
849: 	if(rd_len > buf_len)
850: 		rd_len = buf_len;
851: 
852: 	if(rd_len == 0)
853: 	{
854: 		return 0;
855: 	}
856: 
857: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
858: 	{
859: 		memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
860: 		chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
861: 	}
862: 	else
863: 	{
864: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - rd_idx;
865: 
866: 		if(rem_len > rd_len)
867: 		{
868: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
869: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
870: 		}
871: 		else
872: 		{
873: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
874: 			if(rem_len < rd_len)
875: 			{
876: 				memcpy(data_buf + rem_len, chnl_cb->rx_buf, rd_len - rem_len);
877: 			}
878: 
879: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx = rd_len - rem_len;
880: 		}
881: 	}
882: 
883: 	data_cnt -= rd_len;
884: 
885: 	/* rts assert...... */
886: 	if(data_cnt < ((sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - 1 - MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN) * 8 / 10))
887: 	{
888: 		if( chnl_cb->ctrl_rts != 0)
889: 		{
890: 			chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 0;
891: 			mb_uart_send_state_trigger(chnl_cb);
892: 		}
893: 	}
894: 
895: 	return rd_len;
896: 
897: }

981: void bk_mb_uart_poll(u8 id)
982: {
983: 	if (id >= MB_UART_MAX || !mb_uart_cb[id].chnl_inited)
984: 		return;
985: 
986: 	mb_chnl_poll();
987: 	if (mb_uart_cb[id].link_state == MB_UART_LINK_DOWN &&
988: 		!mb_uart_cb[id].tx_in_process &&
989: 		(int32_t)(rtos_get_time() - mb_uart_cb[id].probe_due_ms) >= 0)
990: 	{
991: 		mb_uart_cb[id].probe_count = 0;
992: 		mb_uart_cb[id].link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
993: 		mb_uart_cb[id].tx_state_req = 1;
994: 	}
995: 	if (!mb_uart_cb[id].tx_in_process && mb_uart_cb[id].tx_state_req)
996: 	{
997: 		if (mb_uart_cb[id].link_state == MB_UART_LINK_PROBING &&
998: 			(int32_t)(rtos_get_time() - mb_uart_cb[id].probe_due_ms) < 0)
999: 			return;
1000: 		if (mb_uart_cb[id].probe_count >= MB_UART_PROBE_MAX)
1001: 		{
1002: 			mb_uart_cb[id].tx_state_req = 0;
1003: 			mb_uart_cb[id].link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
1004: 			mb_uart_cb[id].probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() +
1005: 				MB_UART_DOWN_RETRY_MS;
1006: 			return;
1007: 		}
1008: 		if (mb_uart_send_state_trigger(&mb_uart_cb[id]) == BK_OK)
1009: 		{
1010: 			mb_uart_cb[id].tx_state_req = 0;
1011: 			mb_uart_cb[id].probe_count++;
1012: 			mb_uart_cb[id].link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
1013: 		}
1014: 	}
1015: }

30: /* If a physical channel stays BUSY longer than this (in milliseconds)
31:  * without seeing the matching ACK from the peer CPU, mb_chnl_write() will
32:  * forcibly recover it. Normal mailbox round-trips are << 1 ms, so 200 ms
33:  * is well clear of any legitimate burst while still keeping the system
34:  * responsive in the unlikely event the peer never replies. */
35: #define MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS		200
36: #define MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN			8

39: typedef struct
40: {
41: 	volatile u8		tx_state;	/* physical channel tx state. */
42: 	u8		tx_seq;				/* physical channel tx sequence. */
43: 	u8		tx_log_chnl;		/* logical channel. */ /* bit7~bit4: dst/src CPU_ID, bit3~bit0: log_chnl_idx. */
44: 	u8		tx_hdr_cmd;
45: 	u32		rx_fault_cnt;
46: 	u32		tx_fault_cnt;
47: 
48: 	u32		param1;
49: 	u32		param2;
50: 	u32		param3;
51: 	/* Wall-clock (ms via rtos_get_time()) at which tx_state was set to
52: 	 * CHNL_STATE_BUSY. Used by mb_chnl_write() to detect a physical
53: 	 * channel that has been BUSY abnormally long (peer lost / dropped
54: 	 * the ACK) and forcibly clear it. 0 means "channel is IDLE". */
55: 	volatile u32	busy_since_ms;
56: 	u8		recovering;
57: 	u32		ack_retry_cnt;
58: 	u32		ack_queue_full_cnt;
59: 	u32		reset_bad_cnt;
60: } mb_phy_chnl_cb_t;
61: 
62: typedef struct {
63: 	mailbox_data_t data;
64: 	u8 destination;
65: } mb_ack_entry_t;
66: 
67: 
68: #define CHNL_CTRL_MASK			0xF
69: /*
70:  *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
71:  *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
72:  *  use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
73:  *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
74:  */
75: #define CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX		0x01
76: 
77: #define CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX		0x02
78: #define CHNL_CTRL_RESET			0x04
79: 
80: typedef union
81: {
82: 	struct
83: 	{
84: 		u32		cmd            : 8;
85: 		u32		state          : 4;
86: 		u32		ctrl           : 4;
87: 		u32		tx_seq         : 8;
88: 		u32		logical_chnl   : 8;
89: 	} ;
90: 	u32		data;

122: 	u8				in_used;

135: static mb_log_chnl_cb_t		log_chnl_cb1[CP1_MB_LOG_CHNL_END - CP1_MB_LOG_CHNL_START];
136: #if PHY_CHNL_NUM > 2

148: #endif

151: #endif
152: //	CP0_MB_LOG_CHNL_END - CP0_MB_LOG_CHNL_START, 
153: 	};

156: 	&log_chnl_cb0[0],

159: 	&log_chnl_cb2[0],

161: #if PHY_CHNL_NUM > 3
162: 	&log_chnl_cb3[0],

178: static SPINLOCK_SECTION volatile spinlock_t mb_chnl_spin_lock = SPIN_LOCK_INIT;
179: #endif // CONFIG_SOC_SMP
180: static inline uint32_t mb_chnl_enter_critical()
181: {
182: 	uint32_t flags = rtos_disable_int();
183: 
184: #if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
185: 	spin_lock(&mb_chnl_spin_lock);
186: #endif // CONFIG_SOC_SMP
187: 
188: 	return flags;
189: }
190: 
191: static inline void mb_chnl_exit_critical(uint32_t flags)
192: {
193: #if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
194: 	spin_unlock(&mb_chnl_spin_lock);
195: #endif // CONFIG_SOC_SMP
196: 
197: 	rtos_enable_int(flags);
198: }
199: 
200: /* =====================      physical channel functions      ==================*/
201: 
202: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_tx_cnt = 0;
203: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_rx_cnt = 0;
204: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt = 0;
205: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt = 0;
206: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt = 0;
207: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask = 0;
208: 
209: static inline bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send_safe(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
210: {
211: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
212: 	
213: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
214: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(data, src, dst, arg);
215: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
216: 	
217: 	return ret_code;
218: }
219: 
220: static bool mb_chnl_rx_ready(void)
221: {
222: 	return ack_count < MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
223: }
224: 
225: static void mb_chnl_ack_retry(void)
226: {
227: 	u16 chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
228: 
229: 	while (1)
230: 	{
231: 		mb_ack_entry_t entry;
232: 		bk_err_t ret;
233: 		u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
234: 
235: 		if (!ack_count || ack_sending)
236: 		{
237: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
238: 			return;
239: 		}
240: 		entry = ack_queue[ack_read];
241: 		ack_sending = 1;
242: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
243: 
244: 		ret = bk_mailbox_send_safe(&entry.data, SELF_CPU,
245: 			(mailbox_endpoint_t)entry.destination, &chnl_type);
246: 		flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
247: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
248: 		{
249: 			phy_chnl_x_cb[entry.destination].ack_retry_cnt++;
250: 			ack_sending = 0;
251: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
252: 			return;
253: 		}
254: 		ack_read = (ack_read + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
255: 		ack_count--;
256: 		ack_sending = 0;
257: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
258: 		s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
259: 		mb_chnl_notify((mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[entry.destination],
260: 			phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[entry.destination],
261: 			MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT);
262: 	}
263: }
264: 
265: static bool mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(u8 destination, const mailbox_data_t *data)
266: {
267: 	u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
268: 	mb_ack_entry_t *entry;
269: 
270: 	if (ack_count >= MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN)
271: 	{
272: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[destination].ack_queue_full_cnt++;
273: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
274: 		return false;
275: 	}
276: 	entry = &ack_queue[ack_write];
277: 	entry->data = *data;
278: 	entry->destination = destination;
279: 	ack_write = (ack_write + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
280: 	ack_count++;
281: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
282: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
283: 	return true;
284: }
285: 
286: static void mb_chnl_notify(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *log_chnl_cb_x, u8 count,
287: 			   mb_chnl_event_t event)
288: {
289: 	u8 i;
290: 
291: 	for (i = 0; i < count; i++)
292: 	{
293: 		if (log_chnl_cb_x[i].in_used && log_chnl_cb_x[i].event_isr)
294: 			log_chnl_cb_x[i].event_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[i].isr_param, event);
295: 	}

280: - 每个logical channel一个16字节pending command副本。
281: - 一个独立16字节active slot；发送后直到ACK/reset完成不可修改。
282: - 至少3个AP-owned ACK slots和一个ACK FIFO，容量不小于硬件RX FIFO深度。
283: - AP新建的active/ACK message slot按32字节对齐并位于AP RAM白名单；接收CP envelope只要求原厂ABI的4字节对齐和CP RAM范围。payload SWAP另行精确校验。
284: 
285: slot释放事件必须明确，因为硬件FIFO保存的是地址而不是16字节值：
286: 
287: - command正常收到匹配ACK后可释放。
288: - command timeout后转为quarantine；发送RESET不释放它。RESET和随后STATE使用各自独立稳定slot。只有STATE收到成功ACK，利用同一AP->CP FIFO顺序证明旧command、RESET和STATE都已被复制后，才一起释放旧command和RESET slot。STATE失败时保持quarantine，直到MBOX硬件重新初始化，不能因进入DOWN就复用。
289: - ACK slot不能以“收到对端下一条command”为释放证据，因为对端timeout后可能绕过旧ACK继续发送。只有本端随后一个同方向、需要ACK的普通事务收到成功ACK，才能证明排在它之前的本端ACK envelope已经被对端复制。
290: - ACK pool达到高水位（建议已占用2/3）时，transport必须立即在所有待发ACK之后调度一个独立稳定slot的STATE probe。probe收到成功ACK后，按本端FIFO发送顺序批量释放排在它之前的ACK slots；probe失败则进入DOWN并保持这些slot quarantine。不能依赖heartbeat或应用数据未来恰好出现。
291: - RESET和SYNC都没有自己的ACK。RESET由紧随其后的成功STATE释放；通用SYNC使用独立slot，并在下一个同方向普通事务成功完成后释放。专用slot尚未释放时再次调用同类旁路发送返回`-EBUSY`，不得有限轮转后覆盖。
292: - ACK在DOWN、ABORTING、PROBING和QUIESCING状态下仍是最高发送优先级；状态变化不能免除已经接收的对端command所需ACK。
293: 
294: CP `mbox0_adapter.c`也按相同原则分别管理command、ACK、RESET和SYNC slot，禁止现有“每次发送无条件轮转两个slot”的做法。
295: 
296: 调度优先级保持原厂“logical index越小优先级越高”：HW_CTRL、PWC优先于UART0，避免日志压力阻塞heartbeat和电源命令。ACK永远高于新command。
297: 
298: ### 6.3 ACK和超时
299: 
300: 收到ACK后完整检查：
301: 
302: ```text
303: SID == CPU0
304: ACK_BOX == 1
305: logical_channel == active.channel
306: tx_seq == active.seq
307: cmd == active.cmd
308: RESET/state/reserved组合合法
309: ```
310: 
311: 匹配成功后才释放active slot并调用logical completion。UART completion再根据`COM_FAIL`和`uart_tx_fail`决定成功或失败。
312: 
313: 超时不得直接修改active buffer并重发。第一版策略：
314: 
315: 1. 200 ms无ACK，标记当前transaction失败并保留错误快照。
316: 2. 停止所有普通新TX，向CPU0发送原厂兼容RESET abort通知；RESET使用独立稳定slot。
317: 3. RESET是`ACK_BOX|RESET`单向通知，CP空闲时会忽略，不返回RESET ACK。AP发送成功后进入PROBING，并用独立slot发送后续MB_UART STATE；不能等待不存在的RESET ACK，也不能复用被abort事务的slot。
318: 4. abort发出或收到peer reset后，所有pending非幂等PWC请求以`-ECONNRESET`完成，不自动重放。
319: 5. UART chunk可保留在本地TX ring，重新交换STATE后最多重发一次；日志允许重复风险时也必须通过计数可见。建议默认不自动重发已经可能被对端消费但ACK丢失的chunk，而是丢弃该chunk并累计`tx_unknown`，避免终端出现重复字符。
320: 6. RESET envelope发送失败或后续STATE仍无ACK则link进入DOWN，heartbeat/ready逻辑可检测并执行既定降级或复位策略。
321: 
322: 8位sequence在每次新transaction递增，0可自然出现；本地abort后建立新的软件epoch。不能仅靠wire sequence解决跨reset的极晚ACK。链路状态统一为`DOWN/ABORTING/PROBING/READY/QUIESCING`：ABORTING不发新的普通command，PROBING只发STATE普通command，但所有状态始终优先发送已欠的ACK。
323: 
324: 只有STATE ACK同时满足channel/sequence/cmd匹配、`COM_FAIL==0`、`uart_tx_fail==0`、保留字段合法并成功取得peer RTS时，才能从PROBING进入READY。匹配但带`COM_FAIL`的ACK表示CP尚未open MB_UART0，应在有界退避后继续探测，达到总超时后进入DOWN。
325: 
326: ### 6.4 reset方向
327: 
328: AP transport初始化完成后主动向CP发送一次原厂RESET abort通知，作用是让CP结束可能指向上一个AP boot的in-flight transaction。它不是双向握手：AP不等待响应，而是随后发送STATE探测。收到CP RESET时：
329: 
330: - 对当前active事务生成`-ECONNRESET` completion，但其slot转入quarantine而不复用。反方向收到peer RESET不能证明本端目标FIFO中的旧envelope已经被复制。
331: - 终止本端active/pending outgoing事务并清理其physical busy和peer RTS已知状态；不得清理已经接收且尚未发送的ACK queue。
332: - 保留尚未提交的本地UART TX ring，丢弃不完整AP RX chunk。
333: - 不返回RESET ACK；按原厂语义完成本端abort，再由MB_UART STATE/ACK恢复流控。
334: 
335: CP侧原厂channel层已有处理AP reset并将旧事务以`COM_FAIL`完成的基础逻辑；CP空闲时会直接忽略RESET。上板前需验证当前CP分支未被其他补丁破坏。
336: 
337: quarantine slot只能由后续同方向STATE成功ACK释放，或由明确清空AP->CP目标channel/FIFO的CP侧重初始化、全系统复位释放。AP只重初始化自己的channel 1、IRQ或RX FIFO不能证明CPU0目标FIFO中的旧地址已消失，不得作为释放条件。
338: 
339: ## 7. AP MB_UART0设计
340: 
341: ### 7.1 控制块
342: 
343: AP MB_UART0至少维护：
344: 
345: - `tx_ring`：建议4096或8192字节，用于console/syslog burst，单producer假设不可成立，写入需NuttX spinlock保护。
346: - `rx_ring`：257字节，实际容量256，与原厂语义一致。
347: - 固定AP TX SWAP地址`0x2809fd00`，固定AP RX SWAP地址`0x2809fc00`。
348: - `tx_inflight_len`、`tx_command`、`tx_busy`和`state_pending`。
349: - `local_rts`：AP RX流控；0允许CP发送，1暂停。
350: - `peer_rts`：来自CP command/ACK；0允许AP发送，1暂停。
351: - `rx_irq_enabled`：NuttX serial upper-half当前是否允许接收。
352: - link状态：DOWN/ABORTING/PROBING/READY/QUIESCING。
353: - 分项统计：write/drop、DATA/STATE、overflow、bad pointer/length/CRC、remote fail、ACK timeout、reset、high watermark持续时间。
354: 
355: ### 7.2 AP发送
356: 
357: `write()`只把实际可容纳的字节数写入TX ring并返回该字节数，不返回“部分写入后-ENOSPC”这种不可恢复语义。NuttX serial `send()`每次一个字符，syslog bulk write则循环分片并准确报告短写。
358: 
359: 发送条件：link READY、无MB_UART transaction in-flight、`peer_rts==0`、TX ring非空。每次最多取128字节复制到`0x2809fd00`，构造DATA：
360: 
361: ```text
362: cmd_buff     = 0x2809fd00
363: cmd_data_len = min(tx_count, 128)
364: uart_rts     = local_rts
365: crc8         = 0
366: reserved     = 0
367: ```
368: 
369: 与当前本地代码不同，TX ring读指针在成功ACK后才推进。收到`COM_FAIL`或`uart_tx_fail`时不推进；先记录失败并按reset策略处理，避免原厂“提交logical write即消费，ACK失败静默丢失”的缺陷。
370: 
371: 若没有数据但`local_rts`发生变化，发送STATE。DATA ACK本身已携带最新RTS，因此在DATA处理中可合并待发STATE，但不能丢掉最终状态变化。
372: 
373: ### 7.3 AP接收
374: 
375: 收到channel `0x49` command后先验证header，再处理：
376: 
377: DATA必须同时满足：
378: 
379: - `cmd_buff == 0x2809fc00`，不接受“位于SWAP任意位置”或普通CP RAM中的任意指针。
380: - `1 <= cmd_data_len <= 128`，地址加法无溢出。
381: - `crc8 == 0`且保留位为0。
382: - 当前link允许接收。
383: 
384: 接收前执行共享内存acquire/cache invalidate。只有RX ring剩余空间大于等于整包长度时才整包复制；否则整包不复制，设置sticky overflow并在ACK中置`uart_tx_fail=1`。绝不部分接收后报告失败，否则发送端无法确定消费边界。
385: 
386: 无论DATA还是STATE，都更新`peer_rts=command.uart_rts`。响应ACK包含最新`local_rts`。成功DATA复制后触发NuttX RX处理；ISR内不运行NSH、不格式化日志。
387: 
388: ### 7.4 RTS/CTS水位
389: 
390: 保持原厂兼容阈值：
391: 
392: - RX ring总数组257字节、容量256。
393: - 剩余空间`<=128`时设置`local_rts=1`，确保已经在途的一个最大128字节chunk仍有明确处理结果。
394: - 应用读取后，occupancy低于102字节时设置`local_rts=0`并发送STATE，提供滞回避免状态抖动。
395: - `peer_rts=1`时AP禁止新DATA，但仍允许必要的ACK、RESET和本端STATE。
396: 
397: 由于NuttX还有一层`uart_dev_s.recv` ring，MB_UART RX ring的RTS必须根据“MB_UART ring可用空间”管理；`uart_recvchars()`应及时搬运到NuttX ring。新的`BK7258_MB_UART0_CONSOLE` Kconfig必须`select OTHER_UART_SERIALDRIVER`、`select OTHER_SERIAL_CONSOLE`和`select SERIAL_IFLOWCONTROL`，不能只在defconfig手写隐藏symbol；`OTHER_SERIAL_CONSOLE`再通过NuttX console choice选择`SERIAL_CONSOLE`。
398: 
399: 第一版同时启用`SERIAL_IFLOWCONTROL_WATERMARKS`，upper/lower watermark固定为75%/25%。NuttX upper-half到达75%时停止继续搬运并保持/拉高MB_UART RTS；低于25%后重新调用搬运并释放RTS。若不启watermark选项，NuttX只会在full/empty回调，不能声称具备本文的高低水位行为。
400: 
401: ### 7.5 NuttX serial接入
402: 
403: 正式设备不再冒充物理UART1：
404: 
405: - 注册`/dev/console`和`/dev/ttyMB0`到同一个Mailbox UART device。
406: - 删除`CONFIG_UART1_SERIALDRIVER`、`CONFIG_UART1_SERIAL_CONSOLE`和`BK7258_AP_UART1`误导配置。
407: - 新增板级`BK7258_MB_UART0_CONSOLE`选择，并让NuttX console宏映射到该虚拟设备。
408: - 不执行任何UART1 clock、pinmux或GPIO0/1配置。
409: 
410: `uart_ops_s`实现：
411: 
412: | op | 行为 |
413: | --- | --- |
414: | `setup/attach` | 确认MB_UART已注册callback，不能重复初始化physical mailbox |
415: | `shutdown/detach` | 普通console关闭不销毁全局heartbeat共用transport |
416: | `receive` | 从MB_UART RX ring弹出1字节，status返回overflow/parity sticky快照 |
417: | `rxavailable` | 查询MB_UART RX ring非空 |
418: | `rxint` | 保存enable；enable时投递RX worker或调用受控`uart_recvchars()` |
419: | `send` | 写一个字节到MB_UART TX ring；只在`txready`为true时由upper-half调用 |
420: | `txint` | enable时调用`uart_xmitchars()`，ACK/CTS恢复后再次kick |
421: | `txready` | link ready、TX ring有空间；不要求物理channel当前idle |
422: | `txempty` | NuttX xmit ring、MB_UART TX ring和active DATA都为空 |
423: | `rxflowcontrol` | upper-half高水位时拉高local RTS，恢复时拉低并kick RX |
424: 
425: Mailbox ISR只将DATA复制到MB_UART RX ring并post一个高优先级worker/semaphore。worker调用`uart_recvchars()`，避免在硬件Mailbox ISR里进入完整TTY路径。TX ACK或peer RTS从1变0时，同样由worker调用`uart_xmitchars()`。
426: 
427: ### 7.6 syslog和early putc
428: 
429: - transport ready前允许写入一个小型有界early TX ring；满后丢弃并计数，不阻塞启动。
430: - transport ready后由MB_UART worker排空early数据。
431: - bulk syslog按`size_t`循环，每次传入不超过`UINT16_MAX`，返回实际接受字节数；不能无条件返回原长度。
432: - `sc_force`和`arm_lowputc`仍只能best-effort，不宣称IRQ关闭时可靠。可提供有界flush，例如等待不超过20 ms；禁止永久等待ACK。
433: - 避免console和独立syslog backend重复输出同一条日志。最终配置只能有一个主syslog路径。
434: 
435: ## 8. CP UART0双向桥设计
436: 
437: ### 8.1 唯一MB_UART0 owner
438: 
439: CP只调用一次`bk_mb_uart_dev_init(MB_UART0)`。现有`ap_uart0_log_init()`扩展为统一bridge：
440: 
441: - 注册MB_UART RX callback，唤醒AP输出worker。
442: - 注册MB_UART TX callback，唤醒PC输入发送worker。
443: - 使用有界CP->AP TX ring，建议512或1024字节。
444: - worker根据`bk_mb_uart_write_ready()`处理部分写入，调用`bk_mb_uart_write()`，直到队列为空或peer RTS暂停。
445: - 暴露drop、partial write、MB_UART status、mode switch和last error统计。
446: 
447: 不得为RX和TX分别初始化两次MB_UART0，也不得让日志服务和console服务分别open channel。
448: 
449: ### 8.2 AP输出模式
450: 
451: 提供两个输出策略，但共享同一个MB_UART RX：
452: 
453: 1. `LOG`模式：保持当前按行添加`ap0: `、50 ms半行flush和有限重试，适合AP后台日志。
454: 2. `RAW_CONSOLE`模式：不添加前缀、不等待换行，收到后立即通过CP shell TX queue输出，保证`nsh>`、echo、退格和ANSI字节透明。
455: 
456: 进入AP交互console时切为RAW；退出后恢复LOG。模式切换前先flush旧的半行缓存，防止旧日志与prompt拼接。CP自身异步日志仍可能插入AP终端，第一版应在RAW模式下抑制非关键CP日志或明确串行化，至少不能从两个线程直接写物理UART0。
457: 
458: ### 8.3 UART0输入所有权
459: 
460: CP shell已拥有物理UART0 RX ISR和buffer，因此路由点放在`shell_task.c`读取UART字节之后、执行`handle_shell_input()`之前。状态固定为：
461: 
462: ```text
463: CP_CLI       所有输入由CP CLI处理
464: AP_CONSOLE   原始输入转发给MB_UART0，CP CLI不再解析
465: ```
466: 
467: 上电默认`CP_CLI`。只有满足以下条件才允许进入`AP_CONSOLE`：
468: 
469: - AP已发送Mailbox RESET abort通知并完成STATE/ACK链路探测。
470: - AP已发送IPC power-up和PWC boot ready。
471: - CP bridge确认MB_UART0可写。
472: 
473: CP CLI新增明确命令，例如`ap_console open`。命令handler只设置`SWITCH_TO_AP_PENDING`，不能立即修改owner：先等待当前命令响应和CP TX queue flush，抑制尾随`cp>`，原子清理`cmd_line_buf`、BK_REG/AT/escape解析状态并通过`SHELL_IO_CTRL_RX_RESET`清物理UART RX残留，之后才进入AP_CONSOLE并打印一次切换提示。
474: 
475: AP_CONSOLE保留一个本地退出转义，建议使用行首`Ctrl-]`后跟`.`；解析器只在行首识别完整转义，其他字节原样转发。退出时进入`SWITCH_TO_CP_PENDING`，丢弃未完成转义、停止接收新AP输入、清理或明确丢弃尚未发送的bridge TX，flush AP RAW输出后再恢复CP parser和prompt。退出转义由CP消费，不发送给NSH。
476: 
477: 禁止把同一字节同时广播给CP CLI和AP NSH，否则两个shell会同时echo/执行。下载工具、ATE和bootloader阶段不进入该状态机，维持原UART0 owner。
478: 
479: ### 8.4 PC输入发送
480: 
481: 在AP_CONSOLE状态，CP shell现有UART RX路径读取到原始字节后：
482: 
483: 1. 先运行最小退出转义状态机。
484: 2. 非转义字节写入CP->AP bridge ring。
485: 3. bridge worker根据MB_UART write-ready发送；不得在UART ISR中调用可能触发Mailbox发送和复杂锁的接口。
486: 4. ring满时优先通过MB_UART RTS自然回压；物理UART0无硬件流控，仍可能在高速粘贴时丢字，必须计数并在退出RAW后报告。
487: 5. 可选的软件输入限速按115200估算，但不得sleep在UART ISR；只能由worker分批发送。
488: 
489: AP link down/reset时CP自动退出AP_CONSOLE，清理未发送输入并恢复CP_CLI，避免用户被锁死在无响应终端。为使该行为可实现，CP `mailbox_channel.c`必须新增peer RESET/physical timeout通知，IPC heartbeat/PWC recovery也要向bridge发布AP_DOWN事件；不能从`bk_mb_uart_get_status()`推断link状态。bridge通过统一event callback处理`AP_READY/AP_DOWN/PEER_RESET`，并在事件中只唤醒worker，不直接操作shell队列。
490: 
491: ### 8.5 CP原厂驱动最小加固
492: 
493: 在不改变线协议的前提下同步修复：
494: 
495: - `mb_uart_init()`第二个NULL检查应为`rx_xchg_buff`。
496: - DATA RX校验`cmd_buff`必须等于本端预期`rx_xchg_buff`，长度1..128。
497: - 所有command/response先清零保留字段。
498: - bridge必须正确处理`bk_mb_uart_write()`部分写和`bk_mb_uart_get_status()`。
499: - `mailbox_channel.c`向bridge暴露peer reset/timeout通知；收到AP reset时即使CP physical TX为空也必须发布事件，而不是只记fault后静默返回。
500: 
501: 原厂驱动在logical write成功时提前推进TX ring，远端`uart_tx_fail`时不会回滚。若不重写CP mb_uart状态机，CP输入可靠性仍低于AP改进实现。正式交付建议把CP TX也改为“ACK成功后推进ring”，但这会扩大原厂代码改动。实施可分两步：先完成兼容双向链路并测出失败路径，再将该加固作为进入压力验收前的必做项，而不是长期保留静默丢输入行为。
502: 
503: ## 9. 启动、ready和恢复时序
504: 
505: ### 9.1 CP时序
506: 
507: ```text
508: CP bootloader/download UART0保持原行为
509:   -> CP UART0 115200 8N1和shell初始化
510:   -> Mailbox V2 physical/channel初始化
511:   -> MB_UART0唯一bridge init，注册RX/TX callback
512:   -> 默认CP_CLI模式
513:   -> 启动AP
514:   -> 等待AP IPC power-up
515:   -> 等待AP PWC boot ready
516:   -> 允许用户执行ap_console open
517: ```
518: 
519: ### 9.2 AP时序
520: 
521: ```text
522: CPU1 reset
523:   -> MPU/vector/基础NuttX启动
524:   -> 注册有界early syslog，不访问UART1
525:   -> up_initialize调用arm_serialinit
526:   -> arm_serialinit在uart_register前初始化MBOX0 IRQ79和RX资源
527:   -> 初始化logical transport、ACK pool和MB_UART0 rings/SWAP/callback
528:   -> 创建Mailbox/UART RX/TX worker；允许其在调度器运行后启动
529:   -> 发送单向RESET abort通知，不等待RESET ACK
530:   -> 异步发送STATE(local_rts=0)，arm_serialinit不阻塞等待
531:   -> 注册/dev/console和/dev/ttyMB0
532:   -> board late在worker已运行后有界等待STATE transport ACK
533:   -> 发送IPC power-up并确认transport ACK
534:   -> 启动heartbeat和PWC worker
535:   -> 发送PWC boot ready
536:   -> 启动NSH
537: ```
538: 
539: `arm_serialinit()`运行在公共`up_initialize()`中，OS/driver服务可用，但不得依赖用户初始化线程已经运行，因此这里只安装全部资源并异步kick。STATE ACK的有界等待放到board late，此时worker和系统tick已明确运行。
540: 
541: ready门禁新增：MB_UART RX已能整包复制并调用NuttX worker，TX/STATE完成至少一次探测。日志输出失败不能无限阻塞heartbeat；有界失败后记录link状态，并按产品策略决定继续无console运行还是拒绝ready。比赛调试固件建议MB_UART失败时拒绝ready，避免出现“系统似乎启动但唯一console不可用”。
542: 
543: ### 9.3 suspend/resume和重启
544: 
545: 首版若未完整实现Mailbox PM，必须对相关deep sleep投票禁止进入，不能让CP关闭共享资源后AP仍认为link READY。
546: 
547: 实现PM后流程：
548: 
549: - suspend：停止新DATA，等待active有界完成，拉高RTS，发送STATE，保存统计并关闭IRQ route。
550: - resume：重配CPU1 FIFO/IRQ、清W1C错误、发送单向RESET abort通知、用STATE/ACK探测，再恢复DATA。
551: - AP重启：AP主动发送RESET abort通知；CP transport发布PEER_RESET/AP_DOWN事件，bridge将旧AP TX以失败完成并自动退出AP_CONSOLE。
552: - CP重启：AP ACK timeout进入ABORTING/DOWN，不继续写旧payload；CP恢复后重新执行RESET abort和STATE/ACK探测。

634: ## 12. 测试和验收矩阵
635: 
636: ### 12.1 构建和静态检查
637: 
638: - OpenVela AP `-Werror`构建通过；最终SMP `all-app.bin`完整构建通过。
639: - map中SWAP地址、大小、NOLOAD和AP heap边界正确；AP TX/RX指针分别固定为`0x2809fd00/0x2809fc00`。
640: - GPIO0/1没有UART1 pinmux，二进制无物理UART1 console初始化。
641: - CP覆盖副本与`bk_avdk_smp`目标文件`cmp -s`一致。
642: - 静态扫描不存在ISR内sleep、无界semaphore wait、printf或直接阻塞UART0输出。
643: 
644: ### 12.2 功能
645: 
646: | 用例 | 预期 |
647: | --- | --- |
648: | CP冷启动 | CP log和CP prompt正常，默认不劫持UART0输入 |
649: | AP启动 | 出现带`ap0:`的OpenVela日志，heartbeat无超时 |
650: | `ap_console open` | 切入RAW，出现`nsh>`且prompt无50 ms按行前缀改写 |
651: | NSH输入 | 字母、回车、退格、方向键、Ctrl-C均按TTY语义工作 |
652: | 退出转义 | 不传给AP，恢复CP prompt和LOG模式 |
653: | AP长输出 | 大于128字节正确分片、顺序一致、无覆盖 |
654: | PC高速粘贴 | RTS发生且系统不死锁；超出物理能力时drop计数可见 |
655: | `poll/read` | `/dev/console`和`/dev/ttyMB0`的POLLIN、blocking/nonblocking语义正确 |
656: 
657: ### 12.3 故障和并发
658: 
659: - 注入非法envelope地址、长度、SID、channel、payload地址、129字节长度和非零保留位，均拒绝且计数；有效command收到`COM_FAIL` ACK，不拖死CP physical channel。
660: - ACK FIFO满时不覆盖旧ACK；停止drain或受控恢复。
661: - 丢失DATA ACK后不原地改写in-flight slot，不出现无限重复字符。
662: - stale/wrong cmd/wrong sequence ACK不能释放当前事务。
663: - RX ring不足时整包拒绝，`uart_tx_fail=1`，不部分注入NSH。
664: - AP重启期间CP自动退出AP_CONSOLE；重启后旧输入和旧输出不重放。
665: - CP重启后AP进入DOWN并重新执行RESET abort和STATE/ACK探测，无永久`peer_rts=1`。
666: - 连续10 MiB AP输出、1 MiB双向随机字节和1小时交互期间，heartbeat、PWC和CP UART0不失效。
667: - UART压力下HW_CTRL/PWC优先于UART0，ready和heartbeat延迟有上界。
668: 
669: ### 12.4 最低可观察结果
670: 
671: ```text
672: CP boot...

682: 统计命令至少输出：link/mode、peer/local RTS、TX/RX ring occupancy、active channel/seq/cmd、DATA/STATE计数、drop、overflow、remote fail、bad envelope/payload/ACK、timeout和reset次数。
683: 
684: ## 13. 风险和明确决策
685: 
686: 1. **唯一物理UART复用风险**：UART0同时服务下载、CP shell、CP log和AP console。通过运行期显式owner切换解决，不在bootloader阶段透明桥接。
687: 2. **原厂协议无端到端可靠序号**：transport sequence只关联单次message，ACK丢失后无法判断对端是否已消费。正式策略优先避免重复输入，记录`tx_unknown`并reset，而不是盲目重发。
688: 3. **物理UART无硬件流控**：Mailbox RTS只能限制CP到AP交换，不能让CH340停止已经到达CP UART FIFO的数据。高速粘贴仍需有界CP ring和可见drop。
689: 4. **panic日志限制**：MB_UART依赖中断，不能冒充真正polling UART。验收只要求正常调度和可屏蔽短临界区下工作，不承诺hard-fault关中断后的完整日志。
690: 5. **SMP并发**：当前AP为单核时可用local IRQ lock；正式启用CPU2前，transport和ring必须切换为NuttX SMP-safe spinlock并明确CPU1 owner或跨核代理。
691: 6. **cache**：首版SWAP non-cacheable。任何启cache改动必须两端同时验证，不能只加一个DMB就宣称安全。
692: 7. **CP改动维护成本**：完整输入owner必须修改shell路径，而不是只改`driver.c`。这些文件必须纳入external覆盖和构建说明，否则下一次清理构建会丢失功能。

179: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
180: {
181: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
182: 
183: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
184: 
185: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
186: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
187: 
188: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
189: 	{
190: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
191: 	}
192: 	else
193: 	{
194: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
195: 	}
196: 
197: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
198: 
199: 	if((uart_cmd->cmd_buff == NULL) || (uart_cmd->cmd_data_len == 0))
200: 	{
201: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
202: 	}
203: 
204: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
205: 	{
206: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
207: 		tx_fail = 1;
208: 		
209: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
210: 	}
211: 
212: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
213: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
214: 	#endif
215: 
216: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
217: 
218: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
219: 
220: 	if(uart_cmd->crc8 != cal_crc8_0x31((u8 *)uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len))
221: 	{
222: 		chnl_cb->status_parity = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
223: 		tx_fail = 1;
224: 		
225: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
226: 	}
227: 
228: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
229: 	{
230: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
231: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
232: 	}
233: 	else
234: 	{
235: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
236: 
237: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
238: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
239: 
240: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
241: 		{
242: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
243: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
244: 		}
245: 		else
246: 		{
247: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
248: 
249: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
250: 			{
251: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
252: 			}
253: 
254: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
255: 		}
256: 	}
257: 
258: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
259: 
260: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
261: 	{
262: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
263: 	}

266: 	
267: 	if(free_cnt <= MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN)

270: 	}

273:

275:

283: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
284: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;

286: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)

290: 			/* trigger send! */
291: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);

293: 	}
294: 	
295: 	return;
296: }

355: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
356: {
357: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
358: 
359: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
360: 
361: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
362: 
363: 	if( (ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) || 
364: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
365: 	{
366: 		/*
367: 		 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
368: 		 */
369: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault tx_cmd:%x, rsp_cmd:%x\r\n", chnl_cb->tx_cmd, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
370: 
371: 		return;
372: 	}
373: 
374: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
375: 
376: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
377: 	{
378: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
379: 	}
380: 	else
381: 	{
382: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
383: 	}
384: 
385: 	/* try next Tx. */
386: 
387: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
388: 
389: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
390: 
391: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
392: 	{
393: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
394: 	}
395: 	else
396: 	{
397: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
398: 		{
399: 			ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
400: 			
401: 			if(ret_val == BK_OK)
402: 			{
403: 				chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
404: 			}
405: 		}
406: 	}
407: 
408: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
409: 	{
410: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
411: 	}
412: 
413: 	if(tx_fail)
414: 	{
415: 		// fail handle.
416: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Tx Failed!\r\n");
417: 	}
418:

183: static int send_slot(struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
184:                      uint32_t *order)
185: {
186:   uint32_t wire[2];
187:   int ret;
188: 
189:   wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)message;
190:   wire[1] = sizeof(*message);
191:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
192:   ret = bk7258_mbox_send(0, wire);
193:   if (ret == OK)
194:     {
195:       *order = ++g_send_order;
196:       g_stats.tx++;
197:     }
198:   else if (ret == -EAGAIN)
199:     {
200:       g_stats.fifo_full++;
201:     }
202: 
203:   return ret;
204: }

206: static void release_acks_before(uint32_t order)
207: {
208:   unsigned int i;
209: 
210:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
211:     {
212:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_SENT &&
213:           g_ack_slots[i].order < order)
214:         {
215:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
216:         }
217:     }
218: }

236:       g_diag_state = state;

241: static void complete_transaction(struct active_transaction *active,
242:                                  const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
243:                                  int result)
244: {
245:   struct logical_channel *channel = NULL;
246: 
247:   if (active->channel_index < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
248:     {
249:       channel = &g_channels[active->channel_index];
250:       channel->queued = false;
251:       channel->result = result;
252:     }
253: 
254:   if (active->callback != NULL)
255:     {
256:       active->callback(ack, result, active->arg);
257:     }
258: 
259:   active->busy = false;
260:   if (result == OK)
261:     {
262:       release_acks_before(active->order);
263:     }
264: }

266: static void fail_pending(int result)
267: {
268:   unsigned int i;
269: 
270:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
271:     {
272:       struct logical_channel *channel = &g_channels[i];
273: 
274:       if (channel->queued)
275:         {
276:           channel->queued = false;
277:           channel->result = result;
278:           if (channel->callback != NULL)
279:             {
280:               channel->callback(NULL, result, channel->arg);
281:             }
282:         }
283:     }
284: }

286: static void release_recovery_slots(void)
287: {
288:   unsigned int i;
289: 
290:   g_active.quarantine = false;
291:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
292:     {
293:       memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
294:     }
295: }

297: static void select_recovery_epoch(void)
298: {
299:   unsigned int i;
300:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = NULL;
301: 
302:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
303:     {
304:       if (!g_recovery[i].probe.quarantine &&
305:           !g_recovery[i].reset_sent && !g_recovery[i].probe.busy)
306:         {
307:           epoch = &g_recovery[i];
308:           g_recovery_index = i;
309:           break;
310:         }
311:     }
312: 
313:   if (epoch == NULL)
314:     {
315:       uint32_t newest = 0;
316: 
317:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
318:         {
319:           if (g_recovery[i].probe.order >= newest)
320:             {
321:               newest = g_recovery[i].probe.order;
322:               epoch = &g_recovery[i];
323:               g_recovery_index = i;
324:             }
325:         }
326: 
327:       epoch->replay = true;
328:       g_stats.recovery_replay++;
329:     }
330:   else
331:     {
332:       memset(epoch, 0, sizeof(*epoch));
333:       epoch->reset.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
334:         0, 0, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET, 0,
335:         BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX);
336:     }
337: 
338:   g_probe_attempts = 0;
339:   g_reset_pending = !epoch->replay;
340:   g_stats.recovery_cycle++;
341:   set_link_state(epoch->replay ? BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING :
342:                                  BK7258_MB_LINK_ABORTING);
343: }

345: static void begin_abort(int result)
346: {
347:   struct active_transaction *probe = busy_probe();
348: 
349:   if (g_active.busy)
350:     {
351:       g_active.quarantine = true;
352:       complete_transaction(&g_active, NULL, result);
353:     }
354: 
355:   if (probe != NULL)
356:     {
357:       probe->quarantine = true;
358:       complete_transaction(probe, NULL, result);
359:     }
360: 
361:   fail_pending(result);
362:   g_probe_requested = false;
363:   select_recovery_epoch();
364: }

366: static struct ack_slot *alloc_ack_slot(void)
367: {
368:   unsigned int i;
369: 
370:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
371:     {
372:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_FREE)
373:         {
374:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_QUEUED;
375:           return &g_ack_slots[i];
376:         }
377:     }
378: 
379:   g_stats.ack_overflow++;
380:   return NULL;
381: }
382: 
383: static int dispatch_locked(void)
384: {
385:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
386:   struct active_transaction *active;
387:   struct logical_channel *channel;
388:   unsigned int i;
389:   int ret;
390: 
391:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
392: 
393:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
394:     {
395:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
396:         {
397:           continue;
398:         }
399: 
400:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
401:       if (ret < 0)
402:         {
403:           return ret;
404:         }
405: 
406:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
407:     }
408: 
409:   if (g_reset_pending)
410:     {
411:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
412:       if (ret < 0)
413:         {
414:           return ret;
415:         }
416: 
417:       g_reset_pending = false;
418:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
419:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
420:     }
421: 
422:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
423:     {
424:       return OK;
425:     }
426: 
427:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
428:     {
429:       channel = &g_channels[i];
430:       if (!channel->queued)
431:         {
432:           continue;
433:         }
434: 
435:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
436:         {
437:           if (g_channel_ids[i] != BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX ||
438:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) !=
439:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
440:             {
441:               continue;
442:             }
443: 
444:           active = &epoch->probe;
445:           if (active->quarantine && !epoch->replay)
446:             {
447:               return -ENOLINK;
448:             }
449:         }
450:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
451:         {
452:           active = &g_active;
453:           if (active->quarantine)
454:             {
455:               return -ENOLINK;
456:             }
457:         }
458:       else
459:         {
460:           return OK;
461:         }
462: 
463:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
464:         {
465:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
466:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
467:                  sizeof(active->message));
468:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
469:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
470:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
471:             g_channel_ids[i]);
472:         }
473: 
474:       active->callback = channel->callback;
475:       active->arg = channel->arg;
476:       active->channel_index = i;
477:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
478:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
479:       if (ret < 0)
480:         {
481:           return ret;
482:         }
483: 
484:       active->busy = true;
485:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
486:         {
487:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
488:             {
489:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
490:             }
491: 
492:           g_probe_attempts++;
493:           g_stats.probes++;
494:         }
495: 
496:       return OK;
497:     }
498: 
499:   return OK;
500: }
501: 
502: static bool valid_ack_header(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
503:                              const struct active_transaction *active)
504: {
505:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
506: 
507:   return active->busy && control == BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX &&
508:          bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) ==
509:            bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message) &&
510:          bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) ==
511:            bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message) &&
512:          bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) ==
513:            bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message);
514: }
515: 
516: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
517: {
518:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
519:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
520:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
521: }
522: 
523: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
524: {
525:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
526:   struct active_transaction *active;
527:   bool replay;
528:   int result;
529: 
530:   active = busy_probe();
531:   if (active == NULL)
532:     {
533:       active = &g_active;
534:     }
535: 
536:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))
537:     {
538:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
539:       return;
540:     }
541: 
542:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
543:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
544:     {
545:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
546: 
547:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
548:       return;
549:     }
550: 
551:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
552:     {
553:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
554:       return;
555:     }
556: 
557:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
558:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
559: 
560:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
561:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
562:     {
563:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
564:     }
565: 
566:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
567:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
568:   if (replay)
569:     {
570:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
571:       unsigned int i;
572: 
573:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
574:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
575:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
576:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
577:        */
578: 
579:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
580:       g_active.quarantine = false;
581:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
582:         {
583:           if (i != replay_index)
584:             {
585:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
586:             }
587:         }
588: 
589:       select_recovery_epoch();
590:       (void)dispatch_locked();
591:       return;
592:     }
593: 
594:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
595: 
596:   if (g_probe_requested && g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
597:     {
598:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
599:     }
600: 
601:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
602:     {
603:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
604:         {
605:           release_recovery_slots();
606:           g_recovery_index = 0;
607:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
608:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
609:         }
610:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
611:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
612:         {
613:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
614:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
615:            */
616:         }
617:       else
618:         {
619:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
620:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
621:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
622:         }
623:     }
624: 
625:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
626:            result < 0)
627:     {
628:       begin_abort(result);
629:     }
630: 
631:   (void)dispatch_locked();
632: }
633: 
634: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
635: {
636:   struct ack_slot *slot;
637:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
638:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
639:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
640:   uint8_t state = 0;
641:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
642: 
643:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
644:     {
645:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
646:       if (slot == NULL)
647:         {
648:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
649:           return -EAGAIN;
650:         }
651:     }
652:   else
653:     {
654:       slot = NULL;
655:     }
656: 
657:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
658:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
659:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
660:     {
661:       g_stats.bad_header++;
662:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
663:     }
664:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_RX && g_uart_rx != NULL)
665:     {
666:       ret = g_uart_rx(message, &ack_flags, g_uart_rx_arg);
667:       if (ret < 0)
668:         {
669:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
670:         }
671:     }
672:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
673:     {
674:       g_pwc_rx(message);
675:       ret = OK;
676:     }
677:   else
678:     {
679:       g_stats.unsupported++;
680:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
681:     }
682: 
683:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
684:     {
685:       return OK;
686:     }
687: 
688:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
689:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
690:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
691:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
692:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
693: 
694:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
695:     {
696:       g_probe_requested = true;
697:     }
698: 
699:   (void)dispatch_locked();
700:   return OK;
701: }

703: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
704: {
705:   irqstate_t flags;
706:   uint8_t control;
707: 
708:   flags = up_irq_save();
709:   g_stats.rx++;
710:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
711: 
712:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
713:     {
714:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
715:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
716:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
717:         {
718:           g_stats.bad_header++;
719:         }
720:       else
721:         {
722:           g_stats.resets++;
723:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
724:         }
725:     }
726:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
727:     {
728:       handle_ack(message);
729:     }
730:   else
731:     {
732:       int ret = handle_command(message);
733: 
734:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
735:         {
736:           up_irq_restore(flags);
737:           return ret;
738:         }
739:     }
740: 
741:   up_irq_restore(flags);
742:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
743:   return OK;
744: }

746: static int mailbox_diag_worker(int argc, char **argv)
747: {
748:   enum bk7258_mb_link_state reported = BK7258_MB_LINK_QUIESCING;
749: 
750:   (void)argc;
751:   (void)argv;
752:   for (;;)
753:     {
754:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_diag_sem);
755:       irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
756:       enum bk7258_mb_link_state state = g_diag_state;
757:       bk7258_mb_link_callback_t callback = g_link_callback;
758:       void *callback_arg = g_link_arg;
759:       uint32_t timeout = g_stats.timeout;
760:       uint32_t bad_ack = g_stats.bad_ack;
761:       uint8_t epoch = g_recovery_index;
762: 
763:       up_irq_restore(flags);
764:       if (reported == state)
765:         {
766:           continue;
767:         }
768: 
769:       reported = state;
770:       syslog(reported == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY ? LOG_INFO : LOG_WARNING,
771:              "mailbox: link state=%u epoch=%u timeout=%lu bad_ack=%lu\n",
772:              reported, epoch, (unsigned long)timeout,
773:              (unsigned long)bad_ack);
774:       if (callback != NULL)
775:         {
776:           callback(reported, callback_arg);
777:         }
778:     }
779: 
780:   return OK;
781: }

783: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
784: {
785:   (void)argc;
786:   (void)argv;
787: 
788:   for (;;)
789:     {
790:       struct active_transaction *probe;
791:       irqstate_t flags;
792:       bool request_probe;
793: 
794:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, MB_WORK_INTERVAL);
795:       flags = up_irq_save();
796: 
797:       probe = busy_probe();
798:       if ((g_active.busy &&
799:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_active.started >= MB_TIMEOUT) ||
800:           (probe != NULL &&
801:            clock_systime_ticks() - probe->started >= MB_TIMEOUT))
802:         {
803:           g_stats.timeout++;
804:           if (probe != NULL)
805:             {
806:               probe->quarantine = true;
807:               complete_transaction(probe, NULL, -ETIMEDOUT);
808:               g_stats.probe_fail++;
809:               set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
810:             }
811:           else
812:             {
813:               begin_abort(-ETIMEDOUT);
814:             }
815:         }
816: 
817:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN &&
818:           clock_systime_ticks() - g_down_since >= MB_DOWN_RETRY)

20: #define MBOX_REG(n)             (BK7258_MBOX0_BASE + ((n) * 4u))
21: #define MBOX_CH1_CFG            MBOX_REG(0x20)
22: #define MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG       MBOX_REG(0x21)
23: #define MBOX_CH1_TDATA0         MBOX_REG(0x22)
24: #define MBOX_CH1_TDATA1         MBOX_REG(0x23)

28: #define MBOX_CH1_RDATA1         MBOX_REG(0x27)
29: #define MBOX_CH1_STATUS         MBOX_REG(0x28)
30: #define MBOX_CH0_STATUS         MBOX_REG(0x18)
31: #define MBOX_CH2_STATUS         MBOX_REG(0x38)

34: #define MBOX_CFG_INT_EN         (1u << 8)
35: #define MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN       (1u << 9)
36: #define MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN       (1u << 10)
37: #define MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN      (1u << 11)
38: #define MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS   (1u << 16)
39: #define MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS   (1u << 17)
40: #define MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS  (1u << 18)
41: #define MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS   (MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS | \
42:                                  MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS | \
43:                                  MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS)
44: #define MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK        0x00000fffu
45: 
46: #define MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT      (2u * 3u + 1u)

48: struct mbox_rx_descriptor
49: {
50:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
51:   uint32_t order;
52:   bool used;
53: };
54: 
55: static bk7258_mbox_callback_t g_callback;
56: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor g_rx_desc[MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT];
57: static uint32_t g_rx_order;
58: static bool g_mbox_ready;
59: static struct bk7258_mbox_stats g_stats;

61: _Static_assert(MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT > 2u * 3u,
62:                "RX descriptors must hold a deferred command and two FIFOs");

64: uint32_t bk7258_mbox_rx_status(void)
65: {
66:   return getreg32(MBOX_CH1_STATUS);
67: }
68: 
69: static void mbox_clear_errors(void)
70: {
71:   uint32_t config = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_CFG);
72:   uint32_t errors = config & MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS;
73: 
74:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS) != 0)
75:     {
76:       g_stats.write_error++;
77:     }
78: 
79:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS) != 0)
80:     {
81:       g_stats.read_error++;
82:     }
83: 
84:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS) != 0)
85:     {
86:       g_stats.write_full++;
87:     }
88: 
89:   if (errors != 0)
90:     {
91:       putreg32((config & MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK) | errors, MBOX_CH1_CFG);
92:     }
93: }

95: static bool mbox_valid_envelope(uint8_t source, uint32_t address,
96:                                 uint32_t length)
97: {
98:   if (source != 0)
99:     {
100:       g_stats.bad_source++;
101:       return false;
102:     }
103: 
104:   if (length != BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
105:     {
106:       g_stats.bad_length++;
107:       return false;
108:     }
109: 
110:   if ((address & 3u) != 0 || address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START ||
111:       address > BK7258_CP_RAM_END - BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
112:     {
113:       g_stats.bad_address++;
114:       return false;
115:     }
116: 
117:   return true;
118: }

120: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
121: {
122:   uintptr_t status;
123: 
124:   if (!g_mbox_ready || destination > 2 || data == NULL)
125:     {
126:       return -EINVAL;
127:     }
128: 
129:   /* CPU1 transmits through channel 1.  Full is reported by the target's
130:    * receive FIFO status register.
131:    */
132: 
133:   status = destination == 0 ? MBOX_CH0_STATUS :
134:            destination == 1 ? MBOX_CH1_STATUS : MBOX_CH2_STATUS;
135:   if ((getreg32(status) & 1u) != 0)
136:     {
137:       return -EAGAIN;
138:     }
139: 
140:   putreg32(data[0], MBOX_CH1_TDATA0);
141:   putreg32(data[1], MBOX_CH1_TDATA1);
142:   putreg32(destination, MBOX_CH1_TID);
143:   return OK;
144: }

146: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_alloc_desc(void)
147: {
148:   unsigned int i;
149: 
150:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
151:     {
152:       if (!g_rx_desc[i].used)
153:         {
154:           return &g_rx_desc[i];
155:         }
156:     }
157: 
158:   return NULL;
159: }

161: static bool mbox_priority_message(
162:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
163: {
164:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
165: 
166:   return (control & (BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0;
167: }
168: 
169: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_oldest_desc(bool priority)
170: {
171:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
172:   unsigned int i;
173: 
174:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
175:     {
176:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc = &g_rx_desc[i];
177: 
178:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
179:         {
180:           continue;
181:         }
182: 
183:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)
184:         {
185:           oldest = desc;
186:         }
187:     }
188: 
189:   return oldest;
190: }

192: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
193: {
194:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
195:   int ret;
196: 
197:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
198:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
199:    */
200: 
201:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
202:     {
203:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
204:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
205:         {
206:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
207:           break;
208:         }
209: 
210:       desc->used = false;
211:     }
212: 
213:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
214:     {
215:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
216:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
217:         {
218:           break;
219:         }
220: 
221:       desc->used = false;
222:     }
223: }
224: 
225: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
226: {
227:   (void)irq;
228:   (void)context;
229:   (void)arg;
230: 
231:   mbox_clear_errors();
232: 
233:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
234:     {
235:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
236:       uint32_t address;
237:       uint32_t length;
238:       uint8_t source;
239: 
240:       mbox_process_desc();
241:       desc = mbox_alloc_desc();
242:       if (desc == NULL)
243:         {
244:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
245:           break;
246:         }
247: 
248:       source = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_SID) & 0x0fu;
249:       address = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA0);
250:       length = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA1);
251:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
252:         {
253:           continue;
254:         }
255: 
256:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
257:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
258:              sizeof(desc->message));
259:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
260:       desc->used = true;
261:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
262:       mbox_process_desc();
263:     }
264: 
265:   mbox_process_desc();
266: 
267:   return OK;
268: }
269: 
270: void bk7258_mbox_set_callback(bk7258_mbox_callback_t callback)
271: {
272:   g_callback = callback;
273: }

280:     {
281:       return;
282:     }
283:

287: }
